metadata.name: ghost_checkout
metadata.description: Private, escrowed checkout for social commerce on Solana

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Receives the refund's vault rent. Must be the order's buyer.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Whoever initializes becomes admin/arbiter.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The stablecoin all orders are priced in (USDC).

accounts.name: buyer_token
docs: The buyer's USDC account that pays for the order.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Escrow vault: a USDC account owned by the Order PDA.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone: the buyer, a friend, or a bot. Pays for the buyer's USDC account if missing.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Gets the vault's rent back (they paid it).

errors.name: ImageUrlTooLong
errors.msg: Image URL is too long (max 200 characters)

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidEncryptedAddress
errors.msg: Encrypted address is missing or too long

errors.name: InvalidWindow
errors.msg: Time windows must be greater than zero

errors.name: ListingInactive
errors.msg: This listing is not for sale right now

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatus
errors.msg: The order is not in the right state for this action

errors.name: ShipDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The shipping deadline has already passed

errors.name: ShipDeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: The seller still has time to ship this order

errors.name: InspectionWindowOpen
errors.msg: The inspection window is still open; only the buyer can release early

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: You are not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: SelfPurchase
errors.msg: Sellers can't buy their own listings

types.name: Config
docs: Global marketplace settings. One per deployment, seeds = ["config"].

fields.name: admin
docs: Can update config and is the arbiter that resolves disputes.

fields.name: carrier
docs: The shipping carrier's signing key. Only this key can mark an order delivered.

fields.name: carrier_encryption_key
docs: The carrier's X25519 *encryption* public key. Buyers encrypt their address
to this key in the browser, so only the carrier can read it — never the seller.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The stablecoin every order is paid in (USDC on devnet/mainnet).

fields.name: ship_window_secs
docs: Seconds a seller has to ship after payment before the buyer can be auto-refunded.

fields.name: inspection_window_secs
docs: Seconds after delivery during which the buyer can open a dispute
(e.g. "it's counterfeit"). After this, anyone can release payment to the seller.

types.name: Listing
docs: A product for sale. seeds = ["listing", seller_profile, index_le_bytes]

fields.name: seller
docs: The Seller PDA this listing belongs to.

fields.name: seller_authority
docs: The seller's wallet (denormalised so the frontend can filter cheaply).

fields.name: price
docs: Price in USDC base units (1 USDC = 1_000_000).

fields.name: active
docs: Inactive listings can't be bought.

fields.name: orders_placed
docs: Number of orders placed on this listing.

types.name: Order
docs: One purchase. seeds = ["order", listing, buyer, nonce_le_bytes]
The USDC sits in this PDA's associated token account (the "vault") until
the order is completed or refunded.

fields.name: seller_authority
docs: The seller's wallet (where payment goes).

fields.name: nonce
docs: Client-chosen number so one buyer can place many orders on one listing.

fields.name: amount
docs: Escrowed amount in USDC base units.

fields.name: ship_deadline
docs: Seller must ship before this unix timestamp.

fields.name: release_after
docs: After this timestamp anyone can release payment to the seller.

fields.name: tracking_hash
docs: sha256 of the carrier tracking number — proves which parcel was shipped
without publishing the tracking number itself.

fields.name: encrypted_address
docs: The buyer's shipping address, encrypted to the carrier's key.
The seller only ever sees this unreadable blob.

fields.name: reason
docs: 0 = seller missed ship deadline, 1 = seller cancelled, 2 = dispute lost by seller

types.name: OrderStatus
docs: Where an order is in its lifecycle.
Paid ──mark_shipped──► Shipped ──confirm_delivery──► Delivered ──release──► Completed
├─refund_unshipped (deadline passed)──► Refunded        └─open_dispute──► Disputed
└─cancel_order (seller)──────────────► Cancelled                           │
resolve_dispute ──────┘──► Refunded / Completed

types.name: Seller
docs: A seller's public profile and *un-fakeable* track record.
seeds = ["seller", authority]
The counters below are only ever changed by order outcomes inside this
program, so a seller can't buy fake reviews or delete bad ones.

fields.name: authority
docs: Wallet that owns this seller profile.

fields.name: listing_count
docs: How many listings this seller has created (also the next listing index).

fields.name: completed_orders
docs: Orders that completed and paid the seller.

fields.name: refunded_unshipped
docs: Orders auto-refunded because the seller never shipped in time.

fields.name: cancelled_orders
docs: Orders the seller cancelled themselves before shipping.

fields.name: disputes_lost
docs: Disputes the arbiter decided in the buyer's favour.

fields.name: disputes_won
docs: Disputes the arbiter decided in the seller's favour.

fields.name: total_volume
docs: Total USDC (base units, 6 decimals) the seller has been paid through escrow.
